label: Whatever has every Dei Filius attribute has the primitive classical-attributes field
paraphrase: Open premise, analyst formulation: every being that has every Dei Filius attribute (DeiFiliusAttributes) has the skeleton's primitive field HasClassicalAttributes. The interpretation of the primitive field, stated one-way with no converse: the field's own documentation says it is intended to group the classical attributes after Dei Filius ch. 1, and this premise says that the full list recorded from that chapter suffices for it. It is strictly weaker than STMT-CLASSICAL-ATTRIBUTES-SUFFICE (fieldOfSuffice; Control.Controls part 3). It supplies no existence witness.
